verdict.rationale: treg documents its own per-member tool permissions: admins choose which tools each member may use and whether they may run CLIs locally. Provider credentials are injected server-side, so the agent never holds the raw provider keys. However, the scoping is described per team member, not as issuing a dedicated, scoped token for an agent. missing for 10: explicit issuance of per-agent scoped API tokens, operation- or endpoint-level scopes, expiry/revocation of agent credentials, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: choose **which tools each member may use** and whether they may run CLIs **locally**, at invite time or any time later.
treg injects the credential server-side and relays the answer verbatim.
Authentication uses OAuth with PKCE; do not paste a Treg token or provider API key into Claude.
